events.label: Minnesota Supreme Court rejects Lindell gubernatorial recount bid

slots.name: loss margin
slots.sentence: The Minnesota Supreme Court on Saturday rejected MyPillow founder Mike Lindell’s (R) bid for a recount of the state’s gubernatorial primary election, effectively confirming an 11-point loss that he has defiantly challenged.
